description: Portfolio standard: grouped non-major updates, majors gated behind the dependency dashboard, bounded PR flow. No automerge here - see the 'renovate-ci' preset for repos whose CI runs on pull requests.

packageRules.description: One grouped PR for everything non-major
Majors stay one-per-PR and are only opened once ticked on the dashboard

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes ignore the schedule and are never grouped away
